column1: When *begin_list is NULL there is no last node to walk to, so what must the new element become, and which pointer does the caller see only if you write back through begin_list? Reconsider whether your "walk to the end" loop ever runs (or dereferences NULL) on an empty list, and whether the non-empty case actually links the new node onto the final element rather than the head.

The elements these tests make come from the grader's own ft_create_elem, as the subject says they will from exercise 01 on, never from your ex00: a red here is this exercise's own. Is the prototype layer green too? It checks that your ft_list.h holds the t_list the subject prints, which the grader's elements are built on.
